title: Medigap Switching Rules and Typical Plan G Premiums by State (2026)
note: Typical Plan G ranges are monthly premiums for a 65-year-old non-smoker as of 2026 and vary by insurer, ZIP code, age, gender, and tobacco use. Rules summarized from state insurance regulations, KFF and NAIC publications; always confirm with your state insurance department before switching. MA, MN, and WI standardize Medigap differently and do not sell lettered plans.
